# Build SIBEC prediction model
Uses SIBEC data plus other bounding data sets to create a machine learning regression model of site index and applies to build a predicted SIBEC and a more expansive model for use in climate change forecasting.
May also want a survival model to predict mortality and combine the two models into a predicted 'volume' model for use in the portfolio analysis.
This is probably required with the AMAT and other observation that often a few surviving individuals will have surprising high site index values.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
#options(tinytex.verbose = TRUE)

```

##Import SIBEC data

Read in SIBEC data saved from SIBEC_data_prep.Rmd scripts

```{r SIBEC data import}
sibec.anal <- readRDS("./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.rds") %>% 
 # mutate(SNR = as.numeric(factor(rSNR, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), ordered = TRUE))) %>% 
  mutate(SNR = as.integer(
      factor(SNR, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")))) %>% 
  #mutate(rSMR = as.integer(
   #   factor(rSMR, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5","6","7","8")))) %>%
  mutate(
    DD5 = as.numeric(DD5_an),
    CMD.adj = as.numeric(CMD.adj))


###For random forests probably need some bounding data otherwise no extrapolation into sites outside the training data
###Ensemble models may be better for extrapolation but challenges in getting to prediction 

sibec.coast <- sibec.anal %>% filter(Zone %in% c("CWH", "MH", "CDF"))#, "CMA"))
sibec.interior <- sibec.anal %>% filter(!Zone %in% c("CWH", "MH", "CDF", "CMA")) 
## select set for running models
sibec.tst = sibec.anal
# Step 1: Calculate non-zero SI50 count per TreeSpp
valid_species <- sibec.tst %>%
  filter(SI50 > 0) %>%
  count(TreeSpp) %>%
  filter(n >= 50) %>%
  pull(TreeSpp)

# Step 2: Filter main dataset to retain only those species
sibec.tst <- sibec.tst %>%
  filter(TreeSpp %in% valid_species)

sibec.tst <- sibec.tst %>% filter(rSMR %in% c(3,4), SNR %in% c("2","3"), SlopeGradient <35)
```

## Generate boxplots of site index by site series with phases
This produces a facetted boxplot graph for each species in a BGC showing site index by site series

```{r boxplot species by rSMRxSNR}

SI_spp <- sibec.tst %>% arrange(BGC)#%>% filter(grepl("^SBSmc2", BECSiteUnit))
SI_spp <- drop_na (SI_spp)
# Create separate plots for each BGC
unique_bgcs <- sort(unique(SI_spp$BGC))
unique_bgcs = "SBSmc2"
for (bgc in unique_bgcs) {
  # Filter data for the current BGC
  SI_spp_subset <- SI_spp %>% filter(BGC == bgc)
  
  # Create the plot
SI_plot <- ggplot(SI_spp_subset, aes(x=eda1, y=SI50, fill=rSNR)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8,angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80")
  ) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Site Index by edatopic position ", bgc)) +
  facet_wrap(~TreeSpp)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50))

  plot(SI_plot)
  # Save the plot
  #ggsave(filename = paste0("./outputs/SiteIndex_", bgc, "_rSMR.png"), plot = SI_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
}

```

```{r flag and remove outliers}
sibec.lm <- sibec.tst 
#aspect.class = as.factor(aspect.class))
predictors <- c("DD5_an", "CMD.adj", "PAS_an",  "DD18_an", "solar","VPD_sm","TD")
    #,,", "heat", , , "aSMR""SNR","CMI_an","bFFP","CMD_an","Eref_an",,"rSMR"
sibec.lm <- sibec.lm %>% select(PlotNumber, BGC, TreeSpp, purpose, SI50, predictors) 
#filter species with less than 50 observations
sibec.anal2 <- sibec.lm %>%
  mutate(
    purpose = recode(
      purpose,
      sibec = "data",
      amat = "data",
      edaphic_boundary = "boundary"

  )

n_data <- n_training |> filter(purpose == "data")

sibec.anal2 <- sibec.anal2 |>  filter(
  complete.cases(
    CMD.adj, DD5_an,  DD18_an, VPD_sm,TD,#, heat,  aSMR,Eref_an, bFFP, rSMR,  SNR,CMI_an,
     solar,PAS_an, SI50
  )) |> 
   filter(TreeSpp %in% n_data$TreeSpp[n_data$count > 50])# |> 
 # filter(TreeSpp != "Sx")
```

```{r}
species_metrics <- list()
species_predictions <- list()

final_models <- list(
  rf = list(),
    xgb = list(),
  svm = list(),
  gam = list(),
  stack = list(),
  meta = list()
)

species_list <- unique(sibec.anal2$TreeSpp)

#species_list = "Fd"
# species = "Ss"
for(species in species_list){

  cat(species, "\n")

  spp_data <- sibec.anal2 %>%
    filter(TreeSpp == species)

  if(nrow(spp_data) < 50)
    next
    
  spp_data <- spp_data %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())
set.seed(123)
  split_obj <- group_initial_split(
    spp_data,
    group = BGC,
    prop = 0.8
  )

  train_tbl <- training(split_obj)
  assess_tbl <- testing(split_obj)
set.seed(124)
  cv_folds <- vfold_cv(
    train_tbl,
    v = 5,
    strata = purpose
  )
    model_recipe <- recipe(
    reformulate(
      predictors,
      response = "SI50"
    ),
    data = train_tbl
  ) 
svm_recipe <- recipe(
  reformulate(
    predictors,
    response = "SI50"
  ),
  data = train_tbl
) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
    
      rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(model_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      rand_forest(
        trees = 500
      ) %>%
        set_engine(
          "ranger",
          importance = "permutation"
        ) %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )

  xgb_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(model_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      boost_tree(
        trees = 200
      ) %>%
        set_engine("xgboost") %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )

  svm_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(svm_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      svm_rbf() %>%
        set_engine("kernlab") %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )
    ctrl <- control_resamples(
    save_pred = TRUE,
    save_workflow = TRUE
  )
    ##CV models
    
      rf_res <- fit_resamples(
    rf_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )

  xgb_res <- fit_resamples(
    xgb_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )

  svm_res <- fit_resamples(
    svm_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )
  
# For meta model
  
  row_lookup <- train_tbl %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    row_id,
    SI50
  )
  rf_oof <- collect_predictions(rf_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    rf = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  )

xgb_oof <- collect_predictions(xgb_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    xgb = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  )

svm_oof <- collect_predictions(svm_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    svm = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  )

###build the gam
gam_formula <- SI50 ~
  s(CMD.adj, k = 8) +
  s(DD5_an, k = 8) +
  s(VPD_sm, k = 8) +
  s(PAS_an, k = 8) +
  s(solar, k = 8)+
  s(DD18_an, k = 8)+
  s(TD, k = 8)+
  #s(heat, k = 8) +
  #s(aSMR, k = 5)+
  ti(
  TD,
  DD5_an,
    k = c(5, 5))
  #) +
  # ti(
  #   heat,
  #   DD5_an,
  #   k = c(5, 5)
  # ) +
  # te(
  #   rSMR,
  #   SNR,
  #   bs = c("cr", "cr"),
  #   k = c(5, 3)
  #)

gam_oof <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(cv_folds)),
  function(i){

    split_i <- cv_folds$splits[[i]]

    analysis_dat <- rsample::analysis(split_i)
    assess_dat   <- rsample::assessment(split_i)

    gam_fold <- mgcv::gam(
 formula = gam_formula,
      data = analysis_dat,
      method = "REML",
      select = TRUE
    )

tibble(
      row_id = assess_dat$row_id,
      gam = as.numeric(
        predict(
          gam_fold,
          newdata = assess_dat,
          type = "response"
        )
)
)

  }
)

  ## Build Stack fit
    stack_fit <- stacks() %>%
    add_candidates(xgb_res) %>%
    add_candidates(rf_res) %>%
    add_candidates(svm_res) %>%
    blend_predictions() %>%
    fit_members()
 ##### Fit models
     
## rf fit
     rf_fit <- fit(
    rf_wf,
    train_tbl
  ) 

xgb_fit <- fit(
  xgb_wf,
  train_tbl
)

svm_fit <- fit(
  svm_wf,
  train_tbl
)
##GAM fit
    gam_fit <- mgcv::gam(
formula = gam_formula,
    data = train_tbl,
    method = "REML",
    select = TRUE
  )
## assess predictions
rf_pred <- predict(
  rf_fit,
  assess_tbl
)$.pred

xgb_pred <- predict(
  xgb_fit,
  assess_tbl
)$.pred

svm_pred <- predict(
  svm_fit,
  assess_tbl
)$.pred

gam_pred <- predict(
  gam_fit,
  newdata = assess_tbl
)

stack_pred <- predict(
  stack_fit,
  new_data = assess_tbl
)$.pred
 

### build meta model

meta_train <- train_tbl %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    SI50
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rf_oof %>%
      select(row_id, rf),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    xgb_oof %>%
      select(row_id, xgb),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    svm_oof %>%
      select(row_id, svm),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gam_oof,
    by = "row_id"
  )

meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      c(SI50, rf, xgb, svm, gam),
      is.finite
    )
  )

meta_fit <- lm(
  SI50 ~ rf + xgb + svm + gam,
  data = meta_train
)
summary(meta_fit)
meta_assess <- tibble(
  rf = rf_pred,
  xgb = xgb_pred,
  svm = svm_pred,
  gam = gam_pred
)
meta_pred <- predict(
  meta_fit,
  newdata = meta_assess
)

 meta_fit2 <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  x = as.matrix(
    meta_train[, c(
      "rf",
      "svm",
      "xgb",
      "gam"
    )]
  ),
  y = meta_train$SI50
)

meta_pred2 <- predict(
  meta_fit2,
  newx = as.matrix(
    meta_assess[, c(
      "rf",
      "svm",
      "xgb",
      "gam"
    )]
  ),
  s = "lambda.min"
) |>
  as.numeric()


 
  ### supply model metrics
  metric_df <- tibble(  
  
    TreeSpp = species,

  Model = c(
    "RF",
    "XGB",
    "SVM",
    "GAM",
    "STACK",
    "META_LM",
    "META_GLMNET"
  ),

  R2 = c(
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, xgb_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, svm_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred),
    rsq_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred2)
  ),

  RMSE = c(
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, xgb_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, svm_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred),
    rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred2)
  ),

  MAE = c(
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, xgb_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, svm_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred),
    mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, meta_pred2)
  ),
     n = nrow(assess_tbl)

)

  species_metrics[[species]] <- metric_df
  
  print(metric_df)

cat("\nMETA_LM coefficients:\n")

print(
  stats::coef(meta_fit)
)

cat("\nMETA_GLMNET coefficients:\n")

print(
  coef(
    meta_fit2,
    s = "lambda.min"
  )
)

  # ============================================================
# Build final models using all species data
# ============================================================

# Create folds across the complete species dataset.
# These folds are used to generate OOF predictions for the
# final meta-model and to construct the final stack.
full_folds <- vfold_cv(
  spp_data,
  v = 5,
  strata = purpose
)

full_ctrl <- control_resamples(
  save_pred = TRUE,
  save_workflow = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate full-data OOF predictions for RF, XGB, and SVM
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rf_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  rf_wf,
  resamples = full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
  control = full_ctrl
)

xgb_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  xgb_wf,
  resamples = full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
  control = full_ctrl
)

svm_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  svm_wf,
  resamples = full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
  control = full_ctrl
)

# Lookup connecting .row from collect_predictions()
# to the permanent row_id and response.
full_row_lookup <- spp_data %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    row_id,
    SI50
  )

rf_full_oof <- collect_predictions(rf_full_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    rf = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    full_row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  ) %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    SI50,
    rf
  )

xgb_full_oof <- collect_predictions(xgb_full_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    xgb = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    full_row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  ) %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    xgb
  )

svm_full_oof <- collect_predictions(svm_full_res) %>%
  select(
    .row,
    svm = .pred
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    full_row_lookup,
    by = ".row"
  ) %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    svm
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate full-data OOF predictions for GAM
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gam_full_oof <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(full_folds)),
  function(i) {

    split_i <- full_folds$splits[[i]]

    analysis_dat <- rsample::analysis(split_i)
    assess_dat <- rsample::assessment(split_i)

    gam_fold <- mgcv::gam(
      formula = gam_formula,
      data = analysis_dat,
      method = "REML",
      select = TRUE,
      na.action = na.exclude
    )

    tibble(
      row_id = assess_dat$row_id,
      gam = as.numeric(
        predict(
          gam_fold,
          newdata = assess_dat,
          type = "response"
        )
      )
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Construct final OOF training table for the meta-model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meta_oof <- rf_full_oof %>%
  left_join(
    xgb_full_oof,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    svm_full_oof,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gam_full_oof,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      c(SI50, rf, xgb, svm, gam),
      is.finite
    )
  )

# Defensive checks
if (nrow(meta_oof) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No complete OOF predictions were available for species: ",
    species
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(meta_oof$row_id) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicate row_id values occurred in final OOF predictions for: ",
    species
  )
}

# Keep the column order fixed.
meta_predictors <- c(
  "rf",
  "xgb",
  "svm",
  "gam"
)

meta_x <- as.matrix(
  meta_oof[, meta_predictors]
)

meta_y <- meta_oof$SI50

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit final meta learner using OOF predictions only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

meta_glmnet_final <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  x = meta_x,
  y = meta_y,
  family = "gaussian",
  standardize = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit each base model once using all species observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rf_final <- fit(
  rf_wf,
  data = spp_data
)

xgb_final <- fit(
  xgb_wf,
  data = spp_data
)

svm_final <- fit(
  svm_wf,
  data = spp_data
)

gam_final <- mgcv::gam(
  formula = gam_formula,
  data = spp_data,
  method = "REML",
  select = TRUE,
  na.action = na.exclude
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build final stacks model using full-data OOF results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

stack_final <- stacks() %>%
  add_candidates(xgb_full_res) %>%
  add_candidates(rf_full_res) %>%
  add_candidates(svm_full_res) %>%
  blend_predictions() %>%
  fit_members()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save final models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_models$rf[[species]] <- rf_final
final_models$xgb[[species]] <- xgb_final
final_models$svm[[species]] <- svm_final
final_models$gam[[species]] <- gam_final
final_models$stack[[species]] <- stack_final

final_models$meta[[species]] <- list(
  rf = rf_final,
  xgb = xgb_final,
  svm = svm_final,
  gam = gam_final,
  meta = meta_glmnet_final,
  predictor_order = meta_predictors
)
```

```{r}
final_metrics <-
  bind_rows(species_metrics)

all_predictions <-
  bind_rows(species_predictions)

best_models <-
  final_metrics %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp) %>%
  slice_max(
    R2,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )
gt::gt(best_models)

final_metrics %>%
  select(TreeSpp, Model, R2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Model,
    values_from = R2
  )

final_metrics %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_R2 = mean(R2),
    Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    Mean_MAE = mean(MAE)
  )

ggplot(
  final_metrics,
  aes(
    y = TreeSpp,
    x = R2,
    fill = Model
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge()
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(
  final_metrics,
  aes(
    Model,
    TreeSpp,
    fill = R2
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(R2, 2)),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()
```
check variables importance to model

```{r}
rf_importance <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(final_models$rf),
  function(species){

    mod <- final_models$rf[[species]]

    imp <- mod %>%
      extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
      pluck("fit") %>%
      ranger::importance()

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Variable = names(imp),
      Importance = as.numeric(imp)
    )

  }
)

rf_importance %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp) %>%
  slice_max(
    Importance,
    n = 10
  ) %>%
  arrange(TreeSpp, desc(Importance))
ggplot(
  rf_importance,
  aes(
    Importance,
    reorder(Variable, Importance)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~TreeSpp, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r}
gam_importance <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(final_models$gam),
  function(species){

    s_tab <- summary(
      final_models$gam[[species]]
    )$s.table

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Variable = rownames(s_tab),
      edf = s_tab[, "edf"],
      F = s_tab[, "F"],
      p = s_tab[, "p-value"]
    )

  }
)
gam_importance %>%
  arrange(
    TreeSpp,
    desc(F)
  )

ggplot(
  gam_importance,
  aes(
    x = Variable,
    y = TreeSpp,
    fill = log10(F + 1)
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "log10(F)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
